# Three.js r170 (0.170.0)

Vendored from the published `three@0.170.0` npm package. MIT license: see `LICENSE`.

`three.module.js` is the upstream `build/three.module.min.js`, renamed to keep the
import map readable. The addons are unmodified upstream sources. No CDN or npm
installation is required to serve Life Room.

Keep core and addons on the same version when updating.
